definitions.explanation: A cylinder of wax with a wick that produces light when burned.

examples.japanese: {蝋燭|ろうそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{火|ひ}をつける→火をつける：22628_hiwotsukeru⟧。
⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蝋燭|ろうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: To put candles on a cake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蝋燭|ろうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: We use candles during power outages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蝋燭|ろうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}き{消|け}して→吹き消す：22363_fukikesu⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}した→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧。
examples.english: I blew out the birthday cake candles, and everyone clapped.

notes:
{蝋燭|ろうそく} refers to a candle. The kanji are difficult and rarely written; hiragana ろうそく is much more common in everyday use.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {蝋燭|ろうそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{火|ひ}をつける→火をつける：22628_hiwotsukeru⟧: to light a candle
- {蝋燭|ろうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}き{消|け}す→吹き消す：22363_fukikesu⟧: to blow out a candle
- {蝋燭|ろうそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧: candlelight
- {蝋燭|ろうそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to stand a candle up

CULTURAL NOTE:
Candles are used at ⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧ (Buddhist altars) and during ⟦{法事|ほうじ}→法事：05634_houji⟧ (memorial services). Birthday cakes also use candles (⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蝋燭|ろうそく}).

CONTRAST WITH キャンドル:
⟦キャンドル→キャンドル：28904_kyandoru⟧ (from English "candle") is used more for decorative or aromatic candles, while {蝋燭|ろうそく} covers all candles including traditional and practical ones.
